description: Form 1040 (2025), line 2b: total taxable interest from five declared positive source families: Form 1099-INT boxes 1 and 3, taxable Form 1099-OID box 1, enumerated non-form interest, and Schedule K-1 (Form 1065) box 5.

blocked.explain: Taxable interest is blocked because one or more constituent interest families are unclosed or their dependencies are missing.

closure_backed_zero.explain: A current derived finding publishes a zero because all constituent families are attested closed on their current horizons with no recorded members.

computed_zero.explain: A current derived finding publishes a computed zero from present subtotals that sum to zero. All constituent families are closed.

guard_inapplicable.explain: No value exists because the rule guard is false.

published_value.explain: A current cited derived finding publishes taxable interest from the exact five-family composition, including any Form-1065 K-1 box-5 subtotal.

label: Taxable interest
